notes: κατ' ἰδίαν analysed exactly as at MAT.17.1 (rule 24), and διὰ τί as one noncompositional unit on 'Why' per rule 45's own example.
The juncture 'and' before 'said' goes to εἶπον, the finite verb it introduces (rule 88); προσελθόντες keeps only 'came', the ASV writing no particle for προσ-.
ἐκβαλεῖν keeps the preverb particle 'out' discontinuously around the object (rules 15, 106).
